reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Dynamics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. Our recent update allows for native sparse cellular automata to keep ponds efficient, and terrain modifications like digging and raising now seamlessly integrate with water flow. Plus, activating a well no longer causes frame freezes! Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Dynamics Update in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce improvements to the water system in Provincia! With our latest update, water now flows more realistically with terrain changes, and activating wells no longer causes frame freezes. Experience a smoother city-building journey with these enhancements. Read more about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
